purpose: Challenge the selected share-volume-weighted transaction-price distribution-skew mechanism against every nearby frozen family before any Campaign054 value is computed.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_volume_weighted_transaction_price_bowley_skew_240m
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A right-skewed distribution of executed price levels across share-volume mass represents a longer upper execution tail and may identify persistent willingness to transact at elevated prices.
selected_mechanism.formula: For active bars on the fixed 240-bar grid, x_i=log(amount_i/volume_i), w_i=volume_i, and Q_tau is the smallest sorted x with inclusive cumulative weight at least tau*sum(w). Return (Q_0.75+Q_0.25-2*Q_0.50)/(Q_0.75-Q_0.25).
selected_mechanism.active_and_zero_semantics: volume>0 and amount>0 active; joint-zero inactive; any one-sided zero invalidates the stock-day
selected_mechanism.price_tie_semantics: inclusive weighted empirical CDF with no clock-order tie break

overlap_challenges.reason: VWAP consensus compares share-volume-weighted arithmetic and geometric transaction-price centers and is sign-neutral dispersion. Campaign054 uses only weighted quartile locations and returns signed robust distribution asymmetry; equal dispersion can have opposite skew.

Return skewness uses time-ordered close changes. Campaign054 reads no close, computes no return, ignores clock order after grid selection, and measures price-level asymmetry across executed share mass.

Those mechanisms form adjacent transaction-price returns and correlations with close returns or share-volume changes. Campaign054 forms no adjacent pair, change, correlation, close path, or time-order statistic.

Those factors locate a close or clock-window VWAP relative to another price anchor. Campaign054 reads no close, uses the full-day unordered weighted transaction-price distribution, and has no clock-window anchor.

Campaign053 compares amount mass with absolute close-return mass across return endpoints. Campaign054 reads no close or return and does not align activity with price updates; share volume is only the empirical distribution weight.

Those factors ask where amount occurs in clock time or how amount profiles repeat. Campaign054 discards clock order after selecting bars and sorts by transaction-price level; identical amount clocks can have opposite price-distribution skew.
Candidate49 counts ordered close crossings around a causal cumulative VWAP. Campaign054 reads no close, constructs no causal anchor or crossing, and is historical-only without Candidate49 backfill.

Those factors use minute close levels relative to a tick grid or completed-session close range. Campaign054 uses provider transaction prices derived from amount/volume, weighted price quantiles, no fixed price grid, and no close range.
Campaign054 contains one raw minute statistic and no terminal factor value, fitted weight, filter, threshold, regime, subset, combination, or model.
